appearance.title: Appearance
appearance.themeHint: Changes at once, no restart. The player is always dark

playback.title: Playback
playback.autoplayHint: Playback stops at the end of a season
playback.speedHint: Every run of Kino starts with it
playback.volumeHint: Every run of Kino starts with it
playback.hwdecHint: Less CPU load for 4K and HEVC. Turn it off if the picture has artefacts

tracks.title: Audio and subtitles
tracks.hint: For a series, what you chose in its earlier episodes comes first
tracks.audioHint: If the file has none — as in the file
tracks.positionHint: For SRT and plain ASS; styled ASS place themselves

library.title: Library and history
library.historyHint: Stop positions, viewings and frames. Stored on this computer only
library.foldersHint: Kino looks through them at start and adds new episodes itself
library.clearHint: Stop positions and remembered tracks go too. Folders and episodes stay
library.clearText: All viewings, stop positions, frames and remembered series audio will be removed. This cannot be undone.

downloads.title: Downloads
downloads.folderHint: For torrents without a category and categories without their own folder
downloads.categoriesHint: A new download of a category goes to its folder
downloads.startPaused: Do not start downloads at once
downloads.noSeeding: Do not seed after downloading — straight to the archive
downloads.noSeedingHint: Once downloaded, seeding stops and the torrent leaves the downloads. Files stay, the archive keeps the record
downloads.noSeedingTitle: Move what seeds now to the archive too?
downloads.noSeedingText_one: {{count}} torrent is seeding now. It leaves the downloads, its files stay.
downloads.noSeedingText_other: {{count}} torrents are seeding now. They leave the downloads, their files stay.
downloads.closeToTray: Closing the window — to the tray
downloads.closeToTrayHint: While torrents download or seed, Kino stays in the tray: an icon with the speed, “Pause all”, “Quit”
downloads.notifyFinishedHint: A Windows notification when a torrent is downloaded
downloads.keepAwakeHint: The computer does not sleep while something downloads; the screen goes off as usual
downloads.incompleteFolderHint: A torrent downloads there and, once finished, moves into its category’s folder
downloads.incompleteOff: Off — downloads go straight into the category’s folder
downloads.showAddDialogHint: Off — .torrent files and magnet links go straight to the downloads: the last category, its folder. A torrent from the archive still asks
downloads.deleteTorrentFileHint: The file the torrent was added from; Kino’s archive keeps a copy
downloads.extraTrackersHint: One address per line: http(s):// or udp://. Added to the torrent’s own trackers; lines with # are notes
downloads.altLimitsHint: Download and upload, KB/s; 0 — no limit
downloads.altLimitsOnHint: Same as the gauge button in Downloads
downloads.scheduleHint: The limits go on when the window starts and off when it ends; in between you can switch them by hand
downloads.seedRatioHint: 0 — no limit. A torrent’s own ratio in its parameters wins
downloads.seedTimeHint: Minutes since the download finished; 0 — no limit
downloads.portHint: 0 — a random one at every start
downloads.upnpHint: Open the port on the router automatically
downloads.proxyHint: Peer connections go through it. Empty — no proxy
downloads.proxyError: Needs socks5://host:port, a login is fine: socks5://user:password@host:port
downloads.dhtHint: Finding peers without a tracker; needed for magnet links
downloads.lsd: Find peers on the local network
downloads.lsdHint: Local Service Discovery: computers on the same network with this torrent
downloads.mergeTrackersHint: New trackers of the .torrent or magnet link join the archive record; a running torrent gets them when Kino starts next
downloads.queueHint: the rest wait “Queued” in the order added; 0 — no limit
downloads.skipSlowHint: A torrent slower than 2 KB/s both ways for over a minute takes no place — the next one starts
downloads.handler: Kino as the handler of .torrent and magnet:
downloads.blockAdsHint: By RU AdList and EasyList: ad requests do not load, ad blocks are hidden. The lists update with a new version of Kino
downloads.savePasswordsHint: After a login the trackers browser offers to save the password and fills the form in next time. WebView2 keeps the passwords in Kino’s data folder, encrypted by Windows for your account; Kino itself never sees them
downloads.savedPasswordsHint: Passwords and form data of every site in the trackers browser. Your logins stay
downloads.clearPasswordsText: Passwords and form data of every site in the trackers browser will be deleted. The login you are in now stays.

hotkeys.title: Hotkeys
hotkeys.hint: Click a key in the table, then press the new one. Escape cancels
hotkeys.reserved: {{key}} cannot be assigned: Escape leaves fullscreen, Tab moves the focus
hotkeys.modifier: Shortcuts with Ctrl, Alt and Win are not assigned — press a single key

system.title: System
system.keepAwakeHint: Only while a video plays: the screen stays on, no sleep
system.mediaKeysHint: Pause, next and previous episode from the keyboard and the Windows media overlay — even when Kino is not in front

reset.hint: History, series folders and remembered tracks stay
reset.title: Reset the settings?
reset.text: All settings, hotkeys included, return to the defaults.

updates.label: Check for updates
updates.hint: At start and once a day Kino asks GitHub whether a new version is out. You download and install it yourself
